_about: Hand-maintained overrides for tools/build-places.mjs. Key = the dataset's friendly_id. `tier`/`note`/`name`/`id` here win over the computed values; the override is recorded in places.jsonl (tierBasis "curated", computedTier = what the rules said). `identificationIndex` picks which dataset identification supplies the marker. `extraPassages` adds a reference the dataset verse list lacks (none needed today: the full dataset list already contains Luke 2:4 and Matthew 2:1, which the prototype had to add by hand). `exclude` drops an entry. The 21 entries below come from the GLOBE-001 prototype (design/globe-exploration/build-places.mjs) and are UNREVIEWED tier overrides: Ken approves or changes them (PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_PLAN H row 7).

Eden 1.name: Eden
Eden 1.note: No confident location: the top-scoring identification in the dataset is "unknown location", so no marker is placed on the globe.

Ararat.name: Ararat (region)
Ararat.note: Location disputed: "Ararat" names a region (Urartu); where the ark came to rest is not identified, so the marker is the region's representative point only.

Babel.name: Babel / Shinar
Babel.note: Location uncertain: the dataset identifies Babel with Babylon, but scholars vary, and the exact site of the tower is not known.

Ur 1.name: Ur
Ur 1.note: Location uncertain: Tell el-Muqayyar is the leading identification, but Urfa and other sites have also been proposed.

Goshen 1.name: Goshen (region)
Goshen 1.note: Approximate: Goshen is a region in the eastern Nile delta; the marker is a representative point, not a boundary.

Mount Sinai.name: Mount Sinai
Mount Sinai.note: Location disputed: the dataset lists 14 candidate mountains; the marker shows the highest-scoring one (Jebel Musa), which is a tradition, not a settled fact.
